texts.zh: 这是怎么回事，[From.GetSpeciesName]？！你是想开玩笑吗？！你们不仅没能制止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的错误行为，居然还打算效仿他们！作为正义的一方，我们绝不会姑息。
texts.en: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.

tooltips.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]一定会十分不满，搞不好还会教训我们一番。
tooltips.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be most displeased, and may decide to teach us a lesson.
